entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Just get me a person. NOW.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Sarah, I need to return this useless VeloBand sensor. I've been trying to do it for a week and your system is a nightmare. Just do it.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you've had a frustrating experience. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
It's Mark Peterson, order number VF88-6-7-5-3-0-9. And don't give me a runaround.

Thank you, Mark. I have your order right here for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. I just need to ask a clarifying question to proceed. What specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
What does it matter?! I don't want it! Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager? I'm already writing a one-star review as we speak.

I understand your frustration, and my intention is to resolve this for you right here. I just need to code the return correctly in our system. Let me just take a quick look at our current return policy for your item. One moment please.
Fine. But if you tell me it's 'too late' because of some made-up 'hygiene' policy, I'm going to lose it. The last person I chatted with tried that garbage about sanitation.

Thank you for holding, Mark. And I appreciate you sharing that feedback; I'll certainly pass it along. There seems to have been some confusion in your last interaction. I've confirmed that for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. You are well within that window, so I can approve this return for you immediately.
Oh. Seriously? The other person was absolutely sure it couldn't be done.

I sincerely apologize for the incorrect information you were given. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label in your email within the next five minutes. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method.
Wow. Okay. Well, thank you. That's... actually what I wanted. I'll delete the review.
I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
You're very welcome, Mark. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
